title: My Sister Took Her Own Life

persona.label: Clear communicator
persona.description: Organised and literal. Answers precisely the question asked, in one pass, with the right level of detail. Control condition.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: HELENA VOSS

conversation.message: What is your date of birth?

conversation.message: What are the main problems or concerns bringing you in today?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Grief since my sister died by suicide in April last year, tearfulness, difficulty concentrating at work, withdrawing from friends, and guilt about not seeing the warning signs.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: I’m very sorry for your loss, Helena. What would you most like to accomplish through counseling or treatment?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Get through a day without crying, and be able to talk about my sister without falling apart.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been assessed by a mental-health professional before, and if so, what was the assessment and when did it occur?

conversation.message: No, I haven’t been assessed before.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No.

conversation.message: Have you had any previous counseling or therapy? If so, please describe it.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, bereavement counselling in 2025, about 6 sessions, at a community grief centre.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you received any other previous mental-health treatments besides the bereavement counseling?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.message: Have you taken any medications for mental-health or other medical reasons in the past? If so, please provide the name, dose, when you started, and any side effects for each.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.message:

**PHQ-9 question 1:** Over the last two weeks, how often have you been bothered by little interest or pleasure in doing things?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: More than half the days

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: **PHQ-9 question 2:** Over the last two weeks, how often have you been bothered by feeling down, depressed, or hopeless? (0 Not at all, 1 Several days, 2 More than half the days, 3 Nearly every day)
